title: New model rollout runway and comms checklist
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Purpose: A single, pragmatic runway checklist to coordinate cross-team work for adding a new model to the Redwood Catalog. This ticket collects the pre-launch gates, release notes items, comms templates, and handoff tasks so the PM owner can drive launch readiness across Engineering, Design, Docs, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Support.

Scope: New open-source model 'fastgen-XL' onboarding to hosted API and Dedicated catalog entry. Includes benchmark matrix, concise user-facing docs, release notes, and announcement plan. Does NOT include private deployment packaging (tracked separately under ENG-4209).

Success criteria: model available in catalog UI and API with verified latency/cost profile, release notes published, documentation and quickstart tutorial live, benchmark page up, marketing announcement scheduled, and support/SRE playbooks created.

Where artifacts should live: Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MC/fastgen-XL+onboarding, Design specs: Drive > Marketing > fastgen-XL, Benchmarks dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/bench/fastgen-xl, GitHub PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pulls (link in updates).
checklist_items: Model artifacts and packaging: final model files uploaded, checksums verified, and provenance noted (ENG)
Runtime compatibility: validate model ops on serving runtime (float16/quantized) and run the kernel selection smoke tests (ENG)
Throughput/latency matrix: publish 50, 256, 1024 token profiling for hosted and dedicated configs (ENG/Research)
Cost estimate and recommended profiles: produce suggested quantization & batching defaults per SKU (Product/Optimize)
Security/privacy review: confirm no PII leakage risk, KMS requirements, and mark security_review_required flag if needed (Security)
Catalog metadata: short description, capabilities, intended use-cases, tags, license, and model card draft (PM/Design)
Model card & limitations: document known failure modes, guardrails, and prompt examples to avoid hallucinations (Research/PM)
Quickstart tutorial: code snippets for SDK/REST, streaming example, and function-calling sample (Docs/DevRel)
API compatibility note: enumerate breaking changes vs. existing models or recommended migration steps (API/Eng)
Release notes draft: change summary, performance highlights, breaking/non-breaking notes, and migration notes (PM)
Benchmarks page: publish full benchmark CSV and visual charts, link test harness and seed prompts (Research/Benchmarks)
Console entry: ensure model appears in Redwood Console with per-route telemetry enabled and cost/latency charts wired (Console/Observability)
Rollout strategy: pin rollout percentage, canary criteria, auto-fallback configuration and trigger thresholds (PM/Eng)
Monitoring & alerts: tracing, error budgets, SLOs for new model routes, and alert runbook links (SRE/Observability)
Support playbook: curated troubleshooting steps, expected responses, escalation path, and canned replies for Support (Support/PM)
Sales & Solutions one-pager: feature list, suggested pricing notes, and target customer personas (GTM/Sales)
Marketing assets: blog draft, hero image assets, email announcement copy, and social snippets (Marketing)
Legal checklist: license compatibility, trademark issues, and attribution requirements (Legal)
Release schedule: embargo windows, publish times, and cross-team sync meeting cadence (PM)
Post-launch eval: two-week quality regression checks, token-cost variance check, and user feedback collection plan (PM/Research)
acceptance_criteria: Model passes end-to-end tests on staging, including streaming and function-calling examples
Benchmarks published and validated with reproducible harness (links in updates)
Docs quickstart and model card published with examples and limitations section
Release notes merged into release-notes repo and scheduled for publish
Marketing draft approved and scheduled; announcement assets uploaded
Support playbook and SRE alerting configured and verified
Rollout gates and auto-fallback configured in routing policy
